usage: The term refers to the 'key point' or the most important part of a subject or discussion.
It is commonly used to highlight what should be focused on in explanations, presentations, or arguments.
You can use it to summarize the main ideas or conclusions after elaborating on details.
This phrase often appears in both formal and informal contexts to emphasize significance.
It can be used to guide listeners or readers to understand which aspect matters most.

examples.meaning: The key point of this plan is cost saving.
